title: FunChatRNG
description: A lightweight fun plugin that adds random chat-based commands to make your Minecraft server more entertaining.
body:
# 🚀 FunChatRNG

`Turn ordinary chat into fun interactions with simple RNG commands.`

FunChatRNG is a lightweight plugin that adds fun RNG-based chat commands to your Minecraft server. Roll dice, flip the odds of a statement, and make everyday conversations more entertaining with simple commands that everyone can use.

## ✨ Features
* 🎲 Roll a single dice using /dice
* 🎲 Roll two dice using /doubledice
* ❓ Ask any question with /trueorfalse
* ⚡ Lightweight and fast
* 📦 No dependencies required
* 🔧 Easy configuration
* 💬 Designed for everyday player interactions

## 📸 Screenshots
![/dice /doubledice /trueorfalse /trueorfalse I`m cool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/577b3042b3965c38e552a07f0354a12b3a66a23c.png)

![/dice /doubledice /trueorfalse /trueorfalse I`m cool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07e9e57a5c9d39f275dbc93b19b47392169bfaa3.png)

## ⚙️ Compatibility

### Minecraft Versions

1.21 – 1.21.11
1.26 - 1.26.2

### Server Software

Paper
Purpur
Spigot
Bukkit

## 🎮 Commands
| Command                    | Description                         |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `/dice`                    | Roll a single dice.                 |
| `/doubledice`              | Roll two dice.                      |
| `/trueorfalse <statement>` | Randomly answers **Yes** or **No**. |
| `/funchatrng reload`       | Reload the plugin configuration.    |


## 🔑 Permissions
| Permission               | Default | Description                                |
| ------------------------ | :-----: | ------------------------------------------ |
| `funchatrng.dice`        |    ✅    | Allows using `/dice`.                      |
| `funchatrng.doubledice`  |    ✅    | Allows using `/doubledice`.                |
| `funchatrng.trueorfalse` |    ✅    | Allows using `/trueorfalse`.               |
| `funchatrng.funchatrng`  |    ✅    | Allows access to the main plugin command.  |
| `funchatrng.reload`      |    OP   | Allows reloading the plugin configuration. |

## ⚙️ Configuration

FunChatRNG includes a simple configuration file.

Currently you can customize how dice results are displayed:

```
# ==========================================
#            FunChatRNG v1.3
# ==========================================
# Developed by Zontik
#
# This file contains all plugin settings.
# You can safely edit it while the server is offline.
# ==========================================

#En: Will symbols be used instead of numbers when using the /dice command?
#Ru: Будут ли использоватся символы вместо чисел при использовании команды /dice?
dice_symbol: true

#En: Will symbols be used instead of numbers when using the /doubledice command?
#Ru: Будут ли использоватся символы вместо чисел при использовании команды /doubledice?
doubledice_symbol: true
```
When enabled, the plugin displays UTF-8 dice symbols instead of plain numbers, making chat look more immersive and fun.

## ❤️ Why FunChatRNG?
* Very lightweight
* Easy to use
* No dependencies
* Clean and simple commands
* Perfect for survival and SMP servers
* Makes chat more interactive and entertaining
